visual_review.scope: Geometry/material visual acceptance; diagnostic PNGs are 640px/16 samples, except 128px silhouette and 512px GLB roundtrip. Shared final hero refinement is recorded separately.

identification.reason: The long bent taper, large-to-small torn roots, attached soil and snapped side limbs read from both three-quarter views; the end break includes irregular depth and retained splinters.

form_integrity.reason: Front, side, rear, top and opposite three-quarter views show coherent volumes and deliberate buried intersections, with no unintended spikes, detached parts or open solid surfaces.

planes_and_lighting.reason: Neutral clay, reversed key light and actual triangle wireframes show stable broad planes. Exact GLB re-import shows no new critical creases or missing faces.

family_consistency.reason: Fixed original palette, flat shading, shared rig, measured meter scale and category-specific silhouette match the package contract.

scientific_context.reason: Metadata explicitly labels an evidence-informed stylized concept, separates Carboniferous and Mesozoic context, and records artistic choices.

silhouette_proportion.reason: Strong horizontal trunk and uneven lifted root plate remain recognizable without color.

planes_rhythm.reason: Tapered trunk and a few root/clod masses dominate instead of evenly scattered detail.

color_material.reason: Bark, exposed wood and adhering soil use four fixed palette materials.

craft.reason: Natural fracture depths, tapered branches and closed component meshes survive GLB re-import.

family_reuse.reason: The independent seed-plant deadwood recipe is separate from either living tree and contains no display base.

completed_visual_revisions: Split the initial uniform soil shield into three thicker offset clods behind the visible roots.
Seated a narrower exposed wood patch on the actual trunk loft.
Changed broken end caps to uneven triangulated fracture centers.
limitations: This is seed-plant deadwood, not a lycopsid uprooting reconstruction.
Fine root hairs, fungal identification and a particular fossil death event are intentionally not claimed.
remaining_external_verification: Three.js runtime and combined-gallery performance are owned by the integration task; not certified by these Blender images.

previews.stage: diagnostic pass; final hero quality is recorded separately

reproducibility.comparison: Decoded attributes, indices, materials, scene and nodes; byte-level blend identity is not required.
